claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on Friday, April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
Recovery teams immediately attended to the four-person crew.
The crew module separated from the service module at 7:33 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
The capsule hit the upper atmosphere at 7:53 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
The capsule hit the upper atmosphere causing a 6-minute communication blackout.
The capsule reached the water at 8:07 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
The crew was recovered by the U.S. Navy ship USS John P. Murtha.
